title: SLLV
description: This modpack consists of MCA Reborn, Farmers Delight Refabricated, and a whole host of world terrain altering mods.
body:
Overview
Embark on a refined survival journey that balances world-class exploration with deep domestic mechanics. This pack leverages the full YUNG's Better Structures suite alongside Terralith and Tectonic to create a landscape that is as dangerous to explore as it is beautiful to behold.

Key Features:

    World Reborn: Experience a complete overhaul of overworld and cave generation using Tectonic and Terralith.

    The Gourmet Path: A massive focus on agriculture and cooking with Farmer's Delight and its many expansions (Chef's, Ocean's, and End's Delight).

    Living World: Interact with smarter, more detailed NPCs via Minecraft Comes Alive (MCA) Reborn and explore overhauled villages.

    Performance First: Built on the Sodium and Lithium stack for maximum frame rates, featuring Distant Horizons for breathtaking LOD render distances.

    Dynamic Seasons: Watch the world change with Fabric Seasons, which features full compatibility with the world generation and cooking mods.
